title: Chapter 12 Quiz
description: Test your knowledge of Unity UI: Canvas, RectTransform, Text, Image, Buttons, Sliders, and Layout!

questions.question: Which component is the root for all UI elements in Unity?
questions.explanation: Every UI element must be a child of a Canvas.

questions.question: What are the three render modes of a Canvas?
options: Screen Space – Overlay, Screen Space – Camera, World Space
questions.explanation: These three render modes control how the Canvas is rendered relative to the scene.

questions.question: Which Canvas Scaler mode is recommended for adaptive UI that scales with screen size?
questions.explanation: Scale With Screen Size uses a reference resolution to scale UI proportionally.

questions.question: What is the UI equivalent of Transform?
questions.explanation: UI elements use RectTransform, which adds anchors, pivot, and size properties.

questions.question: What do anchors in a RectTransform control?
options: How the element positions and stretches relative to its parent
questions.explanation: Anchors define how a UI element's position and size adapt to its parent's size.

questions.question: A RectTransform's anchors must always form a single point.
questions.explanation: Anchors can be a point or a rectangle, allowing stretching.

questions.question: What does the Pivot value (0,0) represent?
questions.explanation: Pivot (0,0) is bottom‑left; (1,1) is top‑right.

questions.question: How can you quickly set a UI element to anchor to the bottom‑right of its parent?
options: Use the Anchor Presets menu and select bottom‑right
questions.explanation: The Anchor Presets button provides common anchor configurations.

questions.question: Which property of Text displays the string?
questions.explanation: Text.text holds the displayed string.

questions.question: Rich text tags like bold can be used in the Text component if Rich Text is enabled.
questions.explanation: Unity's Text supports a subset of HTML-like tags when Rich Text is checked.

questions.question: What must you set a texture's import type to for it to be used as an Image source?
questions.explanation: UI Images require sprites.

questions.question: Which Image Type allows a progress bar style fill animation?
questions.explanation: Filled images show a portion of the sprite based on fillAmount.

questions.question: How do you add a listener to a Button's click event via script?
questions.explanation: button.onClick is a UnityEvent; use AddListener.

questions.question: Which UI element provides a draggable handle to select a value within a range?
questions.explanation: The Slider component.

questions.question: The Slider's OnValueChanged event is called only when the user releases the handle.
questions.explanation: OnValueChanged fires continuously as the slider is dragged.

questions.question: Which layout group arranges children in a grid?
questions.explanation: Grid Layout Group organizes children into rows and columns.

questions.question: What does the Content Size Fitter component do?
options: It automatically resizes the RectTransform based on its children
questions.explanation: It adjusts width/height to fit the contents.

questions.question: If you add items dynamically to a Layout Group, how do you force the layout to update?
questions.explanation: You need to force rebuild after modifying children at runtime.

questions.question: Which component allows scrolling of UI content?
questions.explanation: Scroll Rect handles scroll input and moves the content rectangle.

questions.question: What is the purpose of the Mask component?
options: To hide children outside the parent's bounds
questions.explanation: Mask prevents child UI elements from being rendered outside the parent's rectangle.

questions.question: Which method correctly sets a slider's value from script?
questions.explanation: The Slider component's public property is value.

questions.question: What does the Aspect Ratio Fitter do?
options: Makes the element follow the mouse
questions.explanation: Aspect Ratio Fitter maintains the aspect ratio of a RectTransform.

questions.question: A Button created via GameObject → UI → Button automatically includes a child Text and Image.
questions.explanation: The default button has a Text child and an Image background.

questions.question: How do you change a Button's text label from script?
questions.explanation: Get the child Text component and set its text property.
